listing.name: F.E.A.R. (Xbox 360) — F.E.A.R. 360 Recompiled (Juansolo457)
listing.summary: Build F.E.A.R. locally from your Xbox 360 files. Upstream reports campaign and Instant Action support; a full campaign and bonus mission remain unconfirmed, with rendering and performance issues. Native Linux is untested. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Xbox 360 F.E.A.R. files, title ID 565507D9, with default.xex and Game/ under port-nx/assets/. The exact region, revision and hash are not confirmed in the README; check docs/SETUP.md before preparing files. F.E.A.R. Files, title ID 565507E8, is a separate game. Optional PC textures require your own corresponding PC files.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Upstream v0.1.0 releases are source only. On Windows, prepare the patched SDK with tools/setup-sdk.ps1 and locally build the base game with tools/build-nx.ps1 from the matching original disc. tools/launch.ps1 -Collection is an optional shared game-selection route after each title is separately prepared. No public compiled game/player archive is offered by the README; original files stay in the local assets folder.

warnings: Upstream reports startup, menus, intro videos, campaign and Instant Action, high-frame-rate fixes and checkpoint/Continue support. A full base campaign and the Xbox 360 bonus mission remain unconfirmed. GPU spikes in Interval 2, soft fonts and effects/performance issues remain. Steam Deck testing uses experimental Proton; native Linux is untested and Android ARM64 work has not started. Portcove has not confirmed runtime behavior or gameplay.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
